name: use-scroll-spy
title: useScrollSpy
description: Find which section is currently in view, for a table of contents or sticky nav.
a11y: No DOM output. Highlight the active link and keep real links so keyboard and no-JS users can navigate.

props.name: offset
props.description: Pixels from the top of the viewport at which a section counts as reached. Default `80`.

props.name: return
props.description: The id of the active section, or `null` before the first.
